name: Thilan Thushara
profileSummary: Magina Thilan Thushara Mirando;, or Thilan Thushara, is a Sri Lankan former cricketer, who played all formats of the game. He is a left-handed batsman and a left-arm medium-fast bowler. Though he did not represent the country at the international level after 2010, Thushara is an active member in Sri Lanka domestic competitions for Moors Sports Club.
